description: Authoritative list of backend routes permitted to be addressable in the commercial ArchiveMe V1 production deployment. Any route file under app/api that is absent from `routes` fails `npm run check:backend-allowlist`.

capabilityGroups.authentication: Email code issuance and verification for account sign-in.
capabilityGroups.session-and-signout: Server session read and explicit sign-out.
capabilityGroups.encrypted-journal-sync: Canonical end-to-end encrypted journal envelope sync (manifest/pull/push) and the legacy server journal store retained only for migration and export.
capabilityGroups.journal-export: User data export of their own journal.
capabilityGroups.remote-transcription: Remote speech-to-text plus the capture attestation that gates it.
capabilityGroups.minimal-validated-interpretation: The single validated interpretation pass over a transcript.
capabilityGroups.revenuecat-and-billing: RevenueCat linking, entitlement resolution, subscription status, checkout, and billing webhooks.
capabilityGroups.usage-enforcement: Server-side metered usage, pricing, revenue reconciliation and reporting used to enforce plan limits.
capabilityGroups.strict-metadata-analytics: Hashed, content-free metadata counters only. These endpoints reject raw journal content.
capabilityGroups.push: Device push token registration and the internal push delivery self-test the shipping client uses to verify delivery.
capabilityGroups.health-and-readiness: Service liveness/readiness and auth-environment configuration readiness. Not a health-data feature.

Single-entry access to the same legacy server journal store as /api/journal.
Required for the user data-export commitment. Not yet wired in the Flutter client.

Invoked by the vercel.json cron at 15 2 * * *.
Verified content-free: the handler rejects quote/transcript/reflection/journal/text/raw/entry body keys and stores only salted hashes.
Under /api/internal but called directly by apps/voicememory_mobile/lib/api/auth_api_client.dart, so it is a hard-retained client dependency.
Container/nginx readiness probe referenced by docker-compose.yml and nginx.prod.conf. Service health, not a health-data feature.
Auth environment configuration readiness check. Guarded as an internal surface by scripts/validate-debug-guard.mjs and scripts/validate-debug-surface.mjs.

residualSurfaces.detail: The HTTP route handler was moved out of app/api, and server.entry.ts no longer calls attachLiveAudioWebSocketUpgrade, so the raw upgrade listener is not attached under `next start` or the custom server. check-backend-allowlist.mjs fails if the call returns to server.entry.ts, and scripts/build-server.mjs rejects a bundle containing the symbol.
attachCloudRelayWebSocketUpgrade (CLOUD_RELAY_WS_PATH = "/api/sync-relay/ws") is detached from server.entry.ts and guarded the same way as /api/live-audio/ws.

clientCalledRoutesWithNoHandler.detail: The shipping Flutter app POSTs to /api/billing/restore but no handler exists anywhere under app/api, before or after this change. This is a pre-existing gap, not something this change introduced. No handler was invented here; it is recorded so the release owner can decide whether to implement the route or remove the client call.

unwiredValidators.reason: The Next.js web client no longer ships: zero page.tsx files remain under app/. These validators assert copy and structure of deleted web pages and internal panels, so they can never pass again and made the top-level `validate` gate permanently red. They were removed from the `validate` chain only. Every script definition and file is left in place, so any one can be run directly or rewired if the surface returns.
